title: amount
description: One amount as typed in a field, read as the frame's forms read it: a value, a range or a spread, its numbers as typed in the unit it is written in, and what it is, said back; or why not, with the fix. Nothing is written.

nominal.description: The value, or a spread's nominal, as decimal text; null for a range.

lower.description: A range's or a spread's lower end, as decimal text in the unit; null for a value.

unit.description: The unit the numbers are in, as written; 1 for a pure number.

said.description: The amount said back, with its quantity and its value in SI.

message.description: Why it is not read, with the fix.
